release.name: v0.1.1
release.headline: PTv3 multi-head trained in three stages instead of one: a segmentation encoder stage, pretraining on the pseudo labelled T4 base corpus of every platform, and a joint stage on the 10 Hz corpus where every lidar frame carries boxes and masks. v0.1.0 skipped base corpus pretraining and saw keyframes only. Detection and segmentation both improve on every test set, with the largest gains in velocity and orientation error. Read the det3d set with care: v0.1.1 scores detection on the 5910 frames that carry boxes, where v0.1.0 scored 6375 frames because the same run also carried the segmentation frames.

model: Three training stages where v0.1.0 had one: a segmentation only encoder stage, then 24 epochs on the pseudo labelled T4 base corpus of the JPN taxi and JPN taxi gen2 platforms together with the J6 gen2 and large bus corpora, then 10 epochs of joint training. v0.1.0 trained 30 epochs on the j6gen2 corpus alone and skipped base corpus pretraining for schedule reasons

The joint stage trains on the 10 Hz corpus, every lidar frame of the J6 gen2, large bus and JPN taxi releases rather than the keyframes alone, 165630 frames per epoch, with the human joint ground truth rehearsed in at about a tenth of the epoch
Detection taxonomy dropped the train class, 10 classes instead of 11: a train runs on rails the vehicle never shares, so it is no longer a deployed class
Segmentation taxonomy folded the curb class into the flat surface on each side of it, 16 classes instead of 18; the deployed model only needs to know which side of the step a point belongs to
Motorcycles and bicycles are suppressed in one NMS group, so the two wheeler classes no longer keep each other's duplicate boxes
The joint pseudo training is staged on fine box names, so a box keeps the finest label its corpus supports whatever level it was baked for
test: The det3d set is scored on detection alone: 5910 frames of 244 scenes. v0.1.0 reported 6375 frames on the same 244 scenes because its run also read the 465 segmentation frames, which carry no boxes and enter the detection metrics as pure false positives. Part of the det3d gain is therefore test hygiene rather than model quality
Label vocabulary follows the model: no train class in detection and no curb class in segmentation, so those rows show a dash for v0.1.1
The joint set is unchanged, 140 frames of 7 scenes, and the seg3d set is unchanged, 465 frames of 17 scenes
Metric bundle 0.2 as in v0.1.0: region, corridor and collision slices, point level segmentation metrics, confusion matrices
